answer: Make newcomers enter through liable sponsors: each new agent needs an established agent to vouch for it and lock a bond, the way a young willow is staked until its roots hold. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, the sponsor loses the bond and its vouching rights for ten epochs. Sponsors may back only two newcomers per epoch, so a falcon-fast farm cannot spawn hundreds overnight; every clone costs a burned bond and a real reputation, making trust as slow to fake as basalt is to form.
